title: Up on the roofs
subtitle: Ladders, roofs and the jump between them.

sections.name: Street
sections.note: A street of flat-roofed houses: the rooster struts ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstLadder
sections.note: The first ladder: run into it and she climbs; along the roofs, and off the end.

sections.name: FirstGap
sections.note: Two rows with a 1.8 m gap: jump across. A feather above the gap.

sections.name: Clothesline
sections.note: Back on the lane: a clothesline. Slide.

sections.name: CotUp
sections.note: A rope cot before a house with no ladder: bounce up onto its roof.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: A breather: mangoes and a chilli.

sections.name: RoofPots
sections.note: A long row with a pot stack drying on the roof: jump it up there.

sections.name: GapGap
sections.note: Three rows, two gaps.

sections.name: LinePots
sections.note: A clothesline, then pots.

sections.name: CotUpGap
sections.note: The cot up onto a roof, a gap, and a pot stack on the next roof.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A chilli and a long straight.

sections.name: DogLine
sections.note: The dog, then a clothesline.

sections.name: Mischief
sections.note: Dung; the rooster knocks the pots off their stand; then a ladder.

sections.name: RoofTrain
sections.note: Four rows in a train, a pot stack on the third: jump, jump, jump, and down.

sections.name: ChilliLane
sections.note: A breather and a chilli.

sections.name: LinePotsDog
sections.note: Clothesline, pots, the dog.

sections.name: CotRoofs
sections.note: The cot up, a long row with pots on it, a gap, and down.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: The last chilli.

sections.name: LastRow
sections.note: The last ladder, a long row, and down onto the open lane.

sections.name: OpenLane
sections.note: The lane opens out: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 500 m.
